FSSAI Orders Prosecution Against Bisleri Over 'Unsafe' Water Sample

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has approved prosecution against Bisleri International after a sample of its packaged drinking water was found to be 'unsafe'. The sample reportedly contained potentially carcinogenic chemicals, including bromate and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). Bisleri has stated that its water is safe and undergoes over 90 quality tests per bottle, maintaining stringent quality controls. The FSSAI has also collected samples from other major packaged drinking water companies.
